item.description:
### Devices
- Hitting your account's device limit no longer signs you out. A list of your other devices appears; remove one right there to continue on this Mac, or log out instead. - A Mac removed from your account registers itself again when there is room, so notifications keep arriving. - Fixed notifications and remote settings failing to load.
### Home & Guards
- Softer card glow in light mode. - VPN & Tor Block has its own background art. - Risky Words: the add button is easier to see and needs at least 3 letters.
